thread_mute.action.description: Item of a post's menu that mutes the thread (conversation) of the post: the user is no longer notified of replies, mentions, boosts, favourites, reactions, or quotes in it; the posts still appear in timelines.

thread_mute.done.defaultMessage: Conversa silenciada. As publicações dela ainda aparecem nas suas linhas do tempo, mas ela não notifica mais você.
thread_mute.done.description: Toast after the user muted the thread of a post.

thread_mute.failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível silenciar a conversa: {reason}
thread_mute.failed.description: Toast when muting the thread of a post failed. {reason} is the server's or the network's reason.

thread_mute.undo_action.description: Item of a post's menu, in place of 'Mute this thread' while the thread of the post is muted, that ends the mute.

thread_mute.undo_failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível reativar a conversa: {reason}
thread_mute.undo_failed.description: Toast when unmuting the thread of a post failed. {reason} is the server's or the network's reason.

thread_mute.undone.defaultMessage: Conversa reativada. Ela volta a notificar você.
thread_mute.undone.description: Toast after the user unmuted the thread of a post.
